deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'set -e; echo "[migrate] Starting SQLite→Postgres migration"; SQLITE=""; for p in /data/grantflow.db /data/grantflow*.db /app/data/grantflow.db /app/backend/data/grantflow*.db /app/backend/data/*.db; do if [ -f "$p" ]; then SQLITE="$p"; break; fi; done; echo "[migrate] sqlite=${SQLITE:-<not found>}"; if [ -z "$SQLITE" ]; then echo "[migrate] No sqlite db found. Listing:"; ls -la /data || true; ls -la /app/data || true; ls -la /app/backend/data || true; exit 1; fi; node backend/scripts/migrate-sqlite-to-postgres.mjs --sqlite "$SQLITE"; echo "[migrate] Migration finished; starting app"; exec npm start'
